steps: Soak the mustard seeds in warm water for twenty minutes.
Grind them with two chillies, a pinch of salt and a little water into a smooth paste.
Rub the fish steaks with turmeric and salt and leave them ten minutes.
Heat the mustard oil until it smokes, take it off and let it cool a minute; raw mustard oil is acrid.
Add the nigella, pour in the mustard paste let down with half a cup of water, and cook three minutes.
Lay the fish in a single layer, add the remaining chillies whole, cover and stew twelve minutes.
Finish with a spoon of raw mustard oil, take it off the heat and serve with rice.
